description: This file defines data structures and classes for managing a store of nodes (devices or entities) in a networked environment. It includes information about nodes, handles asynchronous refresh operations, and logs activities related to node listing.

classes.name: NodesStore
classes.description: A singleton class managing a list of nodes, handling periodic refreshes, and maintaining connection/status information.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins the periodic refresh loop for nodes.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the current list of nodes from the network.

methods.name: isCancelled
methods.description: Checks whether a given error indicates a cancelled operation.
